paper_title: Anisotropic cosmic optical background bound for decaying dark matter in light of the LORRI anomaly
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (read from Fig.3 axis / converted from decay-rate bound via Gamma = g^2 m^3/(64 pi))
notes: Cosmological bound on decaying ALP dark matter (m ~ 5-20 eV) from COB anisotropy measured by HST, in light of the LORRI COB excess. Primary result is on decay rate Gamma (Fig.2), translated to ALP-photon coupling g_chigamma vs mass in Fig.3 for R=1, q_gamma=2 using Gamma = g^2 m^3/(64 pi). Two bounds (HST 0.606um stronger, HST 0.85um); values here approximate the stronger HST 0.606um curve. Points estimated from Fig.3 (log axis 1e-12 to 5e-10 GeV^-1, mass 5-30 eV); numerical precision limited by plot reading. Not a haloscope, so no local DM density; density used is standard cosmological rho_DM. Bound at 95% CL.
